verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own docs show prebuilt triggers, actions and components for thousands of apps, with managed one-click OAuth or key auth for more than 3,000 APIs; its llms.txt lists 3,223 apps. However, nothing in the pack says these integrations are vendor-maintained: they are described as source-available, and users can contribute new components via GitHub PRs, so who maintains them is unclear. missing for 10: explicit evidence that Pipedream maintains the integrations, a documented maintenance or quality policy for connectors, independent hands-on corroboration of connector breadth and reliability

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
One-click OAuth and key-based authentication for more than 3,000 APIs (use tokens directly in code or with pre-built actions)
you can use pre-built components when you're performing common actions
Pipedream Connect provides managed auth, MCP servers, and API tooling for 3,223
